hotel.eventDescription: One hotel with its lowest nightly rate, stay total and taxes for your dates (row keys name, entity_id, hotel_id, stars, rating, reviews, lat, lng, nightly, total, taxes, fees, total_with_taxes, currency, source, check_in, check_out, google_url): $4 per 1,000 hotels. Address, phone, amenities and photos (includeDetails; keys address, phone, place_id, amenities, photos) ride on this row at no extra charge. Not charged: sold-out or unpriced hotels, duplicates, hotels your filters remove, empty or failed searches, hotel names that match nothing, status rows. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.

offer.eventDescription: One booking site's rate for one hotel and stay (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, official site…) with free-cancellation flag and link (row keys entity_id, hotel_id, name, source, official, room, nightly, total, currency, link, partner_url, free_cancel, free_cancel_until_date, max_guests, lowest, check_in, check_out): $2 per 1,000. Measured: about 18 rows per hotel (4 to 36) with offerLevel "sources", about 65 (up to 150) with "rooms". Not charged when includeOffers is false; maxOffersPerHotel caps the rows per hotel. Failed offer lookups are free.
